jobs.occupation: Accounting and Reporting Manager in Brussels
jobs.description:
This newly created position combines technical accounting expertise, business partnering and people management, offering the opportunity to build and develop a function with significant visibility across the organization.You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders while ensuring accurate reporting, financial transparency and high-quality service delivery.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will oversee accounting and reporting activities for centrally managed costs and third-party managed assets while acting as a trusted finance partner to key stakeholders.

• Partner with central functions such as IT, Legal and other support teams on financial performance and cost management.
• Own the accounting, reporting and control of centrally managed expenditures.
• Manage the reporting and relationship with third-party property owners, ensuring accurate information and timely responses to inquiries.
• Review monthly financial results, analyse variances and provide clear financial insights.
• Coordinate month-end closing activities, reconciliations and intercompany recharges.
• Drive process improvements, strengthen controls and support systems-related initiatives.
• Lead, coach and develop a small team, fostering collaboration and high performance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Solid accounting background with at least 7 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills - French and Dutch
• Previous experience managing and developing team members, with a genuine interest in people leadership.
• Strong business partnering mindset and the ability to build effective relationships with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
• Experience working in an international, multi-entity or shared services environment is a plus.
• Strong knowledge of SAP; experience with ERP implementations or system improvements is highly valued.

Leading a team of three, you will ensure the smooth running of the procure-to-pay cycle, support internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements that contribute to stronger controls and faster supplier payments.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will manage the purchase order administration function and ensure the quality, accuracy and efficiency of related financial processes.

• Lead and support a team of three responsible for purchase order administration activities.
• Ensure purchase orders are created accurately and processed in line with internal procedures.
• Oversee supplier master data management, ensuring vendor information and bank details remain accurate and compliant.
• Maintain product catalogues and ensure pricing, descriptions and accounting information are up to date.
• Act as a key support partner for internal stakeholders, providing guidance on purchase order and supplier administration processes.
• Ensure compliance with approval workflows, financial controls and procure-to-pay procedures.
• Drive process improvements that enhance efficiency and support faster supplier payments.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in Accounts Payable, Accounting, Finance Operations or a similar environment.
• Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.
• Experience leading a team, or the ambition to take the next step from Team Lead to Manager.
• Strong understanding of procure-to-pay processes, purchase orders and supplier data management.
• Hands-on SAP experience is essential.
• A structured and detail-oriented professional with a strong focus on accuracy, controls and process efficiency.

Our client is a european fintech operating in the financial services and payments sector. Its Brussels-based offices offer a dynamic, modern and easily accessible working environment within a rapidly evolving industry.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as the AML Compliance Officer and oversee the organisation's AML/CFT framework
• Supervise KYC, CDD, sanctions screening, PEP reviews and transaction monitoring activities
• Manage, coach and develop a team of 6 compliance professionals
• Review and validate complex investigations and escalate sensitive cases when required
• Maintain and enhance AML/CFT policies, procedures and internal controls
• Coordinate regulatory reporting, audits and compliance reviews
• Collaborate closely with legal, risk and operational teams to ensure regulatory compliance

• Unlimited right to work in Belgium is mandatory for this position : applications without a valid work permit will not be considered.
• Degree in Law, Finance, Compliance, Risk Management or a related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in AML/CFT, compliance or financial crime within financial services, payments or fintech
• Fluent in English; proficiency in French and/or Dutch is considered an advantage
• Strong knowledge of Belgian and European AML regulations, KYC/CDD, sanctions and transaction monitoring
• Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills
• Proven experience leading and developing compliance teams

Our client is a leading international industrial group with operations across multiple continents and an ambitious growth strategy driven by innovation and strategic investments.To strengthen its specialist M&A Legal team, the organisation is looking to appoint a Senior Legal Counsel based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Legal Counsel - M&A, you will act as lead legal adviser on high-profile international transactions.Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the legal execution of domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments.
• Managing complex legal due diligence exercises and coordinating specialist legal input across multiple jurisdictions.
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share purchase agreements, joint venture agreements, transition service agreements, NDAs and other ancillary documents.
• Advising on transaction structuring and identifying pragmatic solutions to legal and commercial risks.
• Partnering with internal stakeholders across Corporate Strategy, M&A, Finance, Treasury, Tax, HR, IT and Compliance throughout the deal lifecycle.
• Managing signing, closing and post-closing processes.
• Supporting integrations, carve-outs and corporate reorganisations following completed transactions.
• Coordinating and managing external legal counsel internationally while maintaining ownership of transaction execution.
• Advising senior management on strategic legal considerations impacting investment decisions.
• Contributing to the continuous development of the company's M&A legal function and best practices.

• Belgian Master's degree in Law.
• Approximately 8  years of post-qualification experience in Corporate/M&A law.
• Experience gained within a leading international law firm and/or a sophisticated international in-house legal environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex domestic and cross-border M&A transactions.
• Excellent drafting, negotiation and project management skills.
• Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate legal complexity into practical business advice.
• Confident communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

jobs.occupation: Group Internal Auditor - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is an established international financial services group headquartered in Brussels. Operating in a regulated and international environment, the organisation combines financial expertise with a strong focus on governance, risk management and internal control.To strengthen its Group Internal Audit department, we are currently looking for an experienced Group Internal Auditor.

Jobomschrijving

• Perform financial, operational and compliance audits across the Group
• Support the Group Chief Internal Auditor in defining and implementing the risk-based internal audit plan
• Independently manage complex audit assignments from scoping to final reporting
• Assess internal controls, governance and risk management frameworks, including IT/ICT-related risks
• Formulate clear and practical recommendations based on audit findings
• Present audit results to senior management and governance bodies
• Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and action plans
• Coordinate audit follow-ups and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Internal Audit function

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance or another relevant field
• At least 7 years of relevant audit experience, ideally acquired within an international environment and/or a Big Four firm
• Strong knowledge of internal audit methodologies, risk-based auditing and internal control frameworks
• Previous exposure to IT/ICT audits is required
• Experience within Banking, Insurance or Financial Services is considered a strong asset
• A CIA, CISA or equivalent professional certification is considered an advantage
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate findings into practical and business-oriented recommendations
• Capable of managing complex audit assignments autonomously from start to finish
• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to combine critical thinking with diplomacy and influence
• Proactive, structured and comfortable working independently within a compact audit team
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, combined with a good command of Dutch and/or French

Are you a hands-on and service-minded professional who enjoys creating a welcoming and well-organised workplace? In this varied role, you will ensure the smooth daily operation of a modern international office while acting as a key contact for employees, visitors and external service providers.
 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

 

Description

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

Our client is an EU organization based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

• Minimum 1-2 years of experience in administration, office management or accounting support.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Good command of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
• Reliable, proactive and solution-oriented approach.

Our client is a highly respected international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and client service. With a collaborative and professional culture, the firm combines high standards with a supportive working environment where people are encouraged to take ownership and make an impact.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the daily operations of the Brussels office
• Lead and support administrative and office services teams
• Oversee facilities, office maintenance, and workplace experience
• Coordinate suppliers, contractors, and external service providers

• Collaborate closely with leadership and international support teams
• Support business continuity, ESG, and office governance initiatives

• Minimum 10 years of experience within a law firm, consultancy, or similar professional services environment
• Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken (mandatory)
• Dutch is a strong asset
• Previous people management or team leadership experience
• Excellent organisational and project management skills
• Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset
• Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Professional, discreet, and service-driven
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office and digital tools
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description: **Location:**  GhentClient confidentialTransport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. This is us, your new colleaguesYou will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.This is the job- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business Are you the one?- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.- Well-being services- Restaurant on site- Opportunity to grow within the company- Good work life balance- International environment- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.Your responsibilities: 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.Working hours are from Monday to Friday in a two-shift system: 
• Morning shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
• Afternoon shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You perform well in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You are stress-resistant and thrive in a production environment where pace is important. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.
